queries:
WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex,
           avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals) AS above_overall
    FROM status_averages
    WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals)
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_modindex,
       above_overall,
       avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  q.rfistat,
  q.avg_modindex,
  100.0 * (q.avg_modindex - oa.avg_modindex) / oa.avg_modindex AS pct_above_overall,
  100.0 * (q.avg_modindex - qm.avg_modindex) / qm.avg_modindex AS pct_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM qualifying
) AS qm
WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_status_average
    FROM status_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        s.rfistat,
        s.avg_modindex,
        s.avg_modindex - o.mean_status_average AS above_average
    FROM status_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.mean_status_average
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex,
    above_average,
    avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_of_status_averages
    FROM status_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex
    FROM status_averages AS sa
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.avg_of_status_averages
)
SELECT
    q.rfistat,
    q.avg_modindex,
    100.0 * (q.avg_modindex - oa.avg_of_status_averages)
        / NULLIF(oa.avg_of_status_averages, 0) AS percent_above_average,
    100.0 * (q.avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying))
        / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying), 0) AS percent_from_qualifying_average
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa;
